text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Excuse meee!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Whoaaa!?
Wh-What's the big rush!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I heard you caught a cold and are in a weak condition!
Hishiama-san, are you taking good care of yourself!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, my fever still hasn't gone down... I feel bad for everyone in the dorm, but I'm resting up.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No problem!
Please rest more and more!
That's why I came!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You always take such good care of me, so today I'm here to help you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
To think Taiki would make porridge for me.
Let's see, one bite—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's tasty. ...Though, this might not really be suitable for a sick person.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Why!? I heard in Japan, you eat okayu when you catch a cold!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Porridge is supposed to be easy to digest. Thick-cut bacon, cheese, and a ton of salt and pepper is a bit much, don't you think...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh... I thought it would be bland, so I made it BBQ style...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I know! I bought cold medicine!
I'll go get some water right now!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hm...? Oh my god!?
This isn't cold medicine, it's stomach medicine!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry! I'll hurry and go buy the right one!
Please wait for me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...*mumble mumble*... Huh!?
Did I fall asleep...!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Honestly... Look, I'm fine on my own, so head back to your room and get some sleep. You might catch my cold if you stay.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh... Nursing someone is really difficult...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...But! Even so!
I won't give up! I will definitely nurse Hishiama-san back to health!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Good morning!
I'm here for my porridge revenge!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what...!?
You came to take care of me again!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Mm! Delicious!
It's a gentle flavor and very easy to eat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That's pretty amazing, Taiki... Did you look up how to make it?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes! Since I couldn't nurse you properly yesterday... I asked my friends for advice!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And they were all so kind... They taught me how to make okayu and how to beat a cold!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And then in the end, everyone made sure to emphasize this—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Above all else, sleeping is the number one cure!
So I'm gonna head back now!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm praying you get well soon, Hishiama-san!
See you later!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day while walking through the academy, I spotted Hishi Amazon and Taiki Shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I really put you through a lot of trouble this time, Taiki. But thanks to that, look—I'm all better!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Because we're friends!!
You can totally rely on friends when you need to!
—Just like everyone does for me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: When you're sad or in pain, being able to lean on each other—that's the mark of true friends!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Please lean on me plenty from now on! And I'll lean on Hishiama-san a whole lot too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Ahahaha, is that right! I really do love that pure side of yours!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Thank you for the compli—
Ah... ah... *achoo*!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
............Ehehe.
Well then, sorry to ask so suddenly, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Could you nurse me back to health?
